marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 十二个月的行道树地图 /文 芸芸 ; 图 阿 米 | Shi er ge yue de xing dao shu di dao

* Introduces 12 common street trees found in Malaysian cities, including natural heritage trees that are more than 100 years old. * Demonstrates the epiphytes of various street trees, as well as the insects, birds and mammals that inhabit the trees. * Guides adults and children on how to observe street trees, with relevant information such as maps and photographs appended as support. * Main content is presented in Chinese with English translation for easy in-depth reading and extended reference. * Suitable for personal reading, parentchild reading, classroom guided reading, picture book activities, environmental education and ecological tours.
